about: Where a side marks a door or a region on a part of what a person sees, or around it, the element measured instead: the closest ancestor of the mark matching closest, or the element inside it matching inside (tools/parity/measure.ts), on the side named. Aliases: a door the design marks that the app draws as other doors. Each says why; docs/PAIRING.md lists them.

faces.why: the app marks the box's label as the box's door while its sides are unlinked; the design marks the box a person sees
the same for the padding box inside it
the app marks the row's icon as the open door (the row's main area is the move door, and a click on it opens the file too); the design marks the row a person sees
the app's door is the path field, invisible until the icon box it sits in is pressed; the box is what a person sees
the same for the new folder
the app marks the matrix's row (its label and the matrix) and each cell; the design marks the matrix
closed, the design marks the chip's positioning box around the chip; the app marks the chip itself
the app marks each direction's button; the design marks the group of them

aliases.why: the closed dock's tabs open the dock at their panel (DEC-02: the canonical strip, Motion beside them), where the design marks them as the tab strip's
the app's context menu asks the component's name first (components.startCreate opens the prompt, the audit's A3.12), where the design's item creates it at once
